As per your request, please find the 6-month rates for Miraclz By Danube

October: AED 9,500
November: AED 12,500
December: AED 16,500
January : AED 14,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

Thank you.
